body:
ADVISORY RE-REVIEW — PASS for the repaired semantic-selection contract; no remaining blocking finding in the reviewed scope. Actor: codex-mockup-implementation-review. This is read-only advisory evidence, not the formal Mote review, landing authorization, or chief acknowledgement.

Binding and scope. In /private/tmp/storyatlas-semantic-proxy-clone I independently resolved HEAD 003f12b21e1b9793fea479e104c2e2eff3e55fe5, tree a6f44747c3f4254c700a7183a2233b9e810e8747, parent 32f4c726424a6327393de26915d0e549ff308fe4; d295f4cd67a472d5a0cc295e1c163f5e97805e2b is an ancestor. The base-to-candidate diff is exactly nine paths, and git diff --check is clean. The source tree remained clean after the audit; only ignored build output was produced.

F1, composite direct plus proxy. The repair moves proxy selection to an independent group filter halo while direct selection retains the child stroke dash; line-level proxy uses borders while direct uses outline. SvgDom adds explicit selection-direct-proxy and focus-direct-proxy state without changing semantic identity. In the live Atlas composite the computed filter was drop-shadow(...1px) drop-shadow(...3px) and the child dash was 6px, 3px. In the real-fragment Codex composite the filter was drop-shadow(...1px) drop-shadow(...2px) and dash was 3px, 2px. The Codex composite also had aria-pressed=true only because the visible ancestor itself was directly selected, retained data-selection-proxy-for for the original, and its label named both roles. The new mutation is load-bearing: STORYATLAS4S_SMOKE_MUTATION=composite node app/smoke/smoke.cjs target/edition/index.html exited 1 with exactly two failed semantic checks, Atlas direct+proxy keeps halo and direct dash and Codex direct+proxy keeps halo and direct dash; both showed filter none while the direct dash remained.

F2, target closure and type discipline. Production Compiled fields are RenderedTargetIndex[MarkId] plus InteractionDecoration[MarkId, Address] for Atlas and RenderedTargetIndex[FragmentId] plus InteractionDecoration[FragmentId, Address] for Codex. Raw strings occur only at DOM serialization, diagnostics, and generic unit fixtures, so MarkId and FragmentId cannot cross at the production compiler boundary. RenderedTargetIndex.build proves exact expected-versus-rendered name equality, rejects duplicate expected and duplicate rendered names, and retains the semantic Address for identity validation. interactionsFor validates every OnMark member independently, rejects empty members, missing or phantom proxy targets, self-proxying, and target-to-visible-address mismatches; OffProjection emits no decoration. The unit court exercises unknown direct and proxy names, a partially missing two-member placement, duplicate rendered identity, and wrong semantic identity. All proof vocabulary and indices are private[app]; no public Intaglio or storymodel4s API was widened.

F3, admitted Codex ViaAncestor capacity. The diagnostic is explicitly labelled Diagnostic and enabled only by interaction-court=1. It starts with a real FragmentId from PaginatedCodex.annotationFragments, locates its actual page, reuses that pages real lowered Intaglio SVG and checked FragmentId target index, applies the synthetic ViaAncestor only in the admitted diagnostic court, then goes through SvgDom injection and the production CSS. The browser proved proxy-only Codex has selection-proxy, aria-pressed=false, a label naming original and visible addresses, and a non-colour computed halo. Activating that fragment resolved through the checked target index to the visible ancestor; recompilation restored ordinary direct Codex treatment and left zero stale proxy classes. The test does not claim that the WOG Codex compiler naturally emits ViaAncestor.

Other contract checks. Atlas proxy-only state had zero selected/focused classes and zero true aria-pressed/aria-current; OffProjection had no direct or proxy Atlas treatment; direct restoration removed proxy state. Intaglio remains renderer-neutral: the change consumes renderer names and SVG at the app boundary, while placement semantics remain storymodel4s SelectionPlacement and all new proof machinery is app-private.

Independent commands and results:
1. git status --short --branch; git rev-parse HEAD HEAD^{tree} HEAD^; git show -s; git diff --stat/name-status; git diff --check; git merge-base --is-ancestor ... — exact binding, clean nine-path scope, ancestor exit 0.
2. sbt -Dsbt.supershell=false -Dstorymodel4s.grakern.build=/Users/bbuchsbaum/code/scala/grakern/.worktrees/pin-0329c43 app/test — exit 0, 22 passed, 0 failed.
3. sbt -Dsbt.supershell=false -Dstorymodel4s.grakern.build=/Users/bbuchsbaum/code/scala/grakern/.worktrees/pin-0329c43 "cli/run edition --out target/edition" app/editionBundle — exit 0.
4. node app/smoke/smoke.cjs target/edition/index.html — exit 0, smoke passed, including Atlas and Codex computed styles, truthful ARIA, activation, and restoration.
5. STORYATLAS4S_SMOKE_MUTATION=composite node app/smoke/smoke.cjs target/edition/index.html — expected exit 1, exactly the two composite halo assertions failed.
6. Browser ownership audit before and after both browser runs — no automated top-level browser processes found.

Disposition: prior F1-F3 and the raw-string/public-proof type note are repaired at this exact candidate. No remaining finding from this advisory pass.
